A data center industry aggregator directorys Roanoke area listing hit a page view limit, a local business press search was blocked, a community discussion forum search was blocked, and the operators own corporate locations page returned a not found error. Given no source produced a confirmed, corroborated address, none is applied, consistent with this appearing to be a private corporate facility not typically listed in public data center directories.
